note: Approved decorative or brand SVG exceptions only; functional icons must use lucide-react. Raw colors are a shrinking legacy ceiling, not permission for new values. SaZones.tsx kini memakai peta Leaflet (tanpa SVG inline) sehingga entri SVG-nya kosong. DonutChart.tsx holds the Ringkasan donut: arcs need SVG stroke-dasharray, and it is a data graphic, not an icon; bars in the same dashboard are plain HTML/CSS. Sparkline.tsx holds the merchant revenue sparkline: a line needs a polyline path, which HTML/CSS cannot draw, and it is a data graphic with an aria-label carrying the numbers, not an icon. HomePromoCarousel.tsx holds the promo-card background waves and dot texture: the same decorative motif as the home hero, opacity kept at 4-14%, not functional icons.
